description: A pre-PR reviewer's findings on the change from the base commit to the head commit, read in the checkout

implement.description: The implement Ref this request gave, whose local_head is the head commit, copied byte-exact from request.inputs

findings.description: One item per problem found. An empty list means none was found, which is not proof that the change is correct or matches the design doc

id.description: Identifies the finding, unique among this contract's findings

path.description: The file the finding is about, relative to the repository root, when it has one

line.description: The line in path at the head commit

detail.description: What is wrong and the evidence for it

design_ref.description: Where the design doc snapshot states what the finding is measured against

limitations.description: What could not be reviewed and why; empty when nothing was left out
